verdict.rationale: MailerSend's own docs say transactional email can be sent through an SMTP relay as an alternative to the Email API, including from existing software or services, which fits the legacy-app case. The evidence does not show how SMTP credentials are generated or managed, or give connection details. Missing for 10: documented SMTP credential generation/management, relay host/port/auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send through a documented SMTP relay with generated credentials when my framework or legacy app can't call the REST API

citations.quote: At the moment, transactional emails can be sent through MailerSend’s Email API or using SMTP relay.
Use MailerSend's SMTP to send emails via existing software or services.
